findings.passage: “It’s no coincidence that the two women who are being paired against each other are the same two women who refused to waiver in the fight to protect voting rights,” Ordaz Perez said.
findings.note: Quoted by the Texas Tribune. She links her new district pairing to her part in the 2021 quorum break over the state elections bill. It speaks of voting rights in general, not ID.

findings.passage: During her first session, she was named “Freshman Legislator” of the year by the Tejano Democrats for her work in fighting for voting rights.
findings.note: Line on her official House biography about her first session. It speaks of voting rights in general and names no ID or citizenship rule. The page carries no date.
